items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: Bourgeois recommended me they made contact

ctx.x: What -- what brought you to your decision that you were not going to go on with a group, but you'd travel as a single? You just came to realize how much simpler it was?

No, I think when they were opening Michael's Pub, I'll tell you the story, they were opening Michael's Pub, Bourgeois recommended me they made contact, I knew Charlie Bushwa director or something, cause I -- been working with George before, I went into that two-year job and Tropicana in Vegas. So, I'd been off and so they contacted me about coming here, but they were delayed so when I went up to see Mark in Vegas, during the summer and they called me I was already booked in Vegas. I was working so I couldn't do it.
